deep_analysis.executive_intro:
Across 248 names, the screen is cautious overall: 134 holds and 54 avoids versus 14 strong buys and 46 buys (about 24% on the positive side). The five highest-ranked names are all headline strong buys, but every one is adjusted down to buy after FCF-basis and related overlays, and none clears the dividend factor family despite attractive quoted yields on several names. Sector clustering is pronounced at the top: three of five are Industrials (MEGP.L, FGP.L, MGNS.L), with HIK.L in Healthcare and MONY.L in Communication Services. Conviction is moderate (roughly 51–59%) and mostly stable over 23 weeks, except MONY.L at five weeks. Treat headline yield and cheapness passes as provisional until filing-aligned free cash flow, statutory OCF−CapEx cover, and any management “cash-generated” bridges are reconciled—the JSON flags material filing vs screen TTM divergence on most top picks.

MEGP.L (ME Group International plc, Industrials) — Headline strong buy (12/22 models, composite 84%, sector-relative 90%) with four of five families (cheapness, quality, GARP, risk; dividend family failed). Quantitative support includes Graham Enterprising, Earnings Yield, Low P/E + High Yield, Neff PEGY, Quality Value, Buffett Quality, Economic Moat, Magic Formula, Acquirer’s Multiple, Dreman Contrarian, Composite Value, and Financial Health, on metrics such as P/E 7.9, P/B 2.2, yield 7.1%, ROE 28.2%, and screen D/E 28%. Overlays cut the signal to buy: interim-quality (interim EPS decline, net FCF/dividend cover below 1.0×), cyclical discretionary exposure, and FCF basis mismatch (filing £25.2M vs screen TTM £15.6M; statutory cover 0.84× vs management 1.68×). Piotroski 6/9 failed; FCF Yield and dividend models suppressed or failed. Industrials concentration adds correlated cyclical risk with FGP.L and MGNS.L. Verdict: watchlist — attractive valuation and quality passes, but net statutory dividend cover below 1.0× and cyclical/interim overlays warrant filing-level confirmation before sizing.

FGP.L (FirstGroup plc, Industrials) — Strong buy (13/22 models, composite 85%) adjusted to buy; four families pass including Lynch PEG (filing adjusted EPS growth 16.0% vs screen TTM −5.9%). Passes add Piotroski 8/9 and Earnings Quality alongside the usual value/quality set; key metrics P/E 9.1, P/B 1.4, yield 4.0%, ROE 16.7%, with leverage override (Yahoo D/E 161% vs £137.7m adjusted net debt and screen D/E 19%). FCF is triangulated awkwardly: filing £362.6M, screen TTM £302.8M, company-adjusted £73.8M (policy basis), with action note statutory 9.32× dividend coverage on one definition vs ~1.90× on the company-adjusted basis in research prompts. Failed Financial Health (weak liquidity; current ratio 0.73) and Economic Moat. Same Industrials cluster as peers above. Verdict: accumulate — deep model support and strong Piotroski, but only after accepting that dividend/FCF comfort depends on which FCF definition governs and that liquidity metrics are weak on the screen.

MGNS.L (Morgan Sindall Group plc, Industrials) — Strongest model count in the top five (14/22, composite 80%, sector-relative 82%) with Lynch PEG, Piotroski 8/9, Earnings Quality, and Financial Health among passes; P/E 11.0, P/B 2.6, yield 3.9%, ROE 26.1%, D/E 18%, earnings growth 18.8%. FCF basis overlay: filing £170.7M vs screen TTM £141.5M; statutory dividend cover 2.59× (gross ~2.45×). Dividend family still fails (High Dividend Yield not top quartile; Dividend Growth suppressed for FCF basis). Third Industrials name—UK construction/contrading cyclicality is a shared theme. Verdict: accumulate — broadest pass set and filing-aligned cover above 2× on statutory basis, with sector cyclicality as the main offset.

HIK.L (Hikma Pharmaceuticals PLC, Healthcare) — Strong buy (11/22 models, composite 76%) adjusted to buy; four families pass on P/E 11.9, P/B 1.8, yield 4.1%, ROE 15.4%, D/E 77%. Passes mirror MEGP-style value/quality screens but Lynch PEG fails (screen earnings growth −4.7%), Piotroski 6/9 fails, FCF Yield 3.6% below 5%, and Economic Moat fails on ROE/ROA/margins/leverage. Extreme FCF gap: filing $119M vs screen TTM $14.4M; statutory cover 0.64× vs management 1.31×. Healthcare diversifies the Industrials-heavy top list but introduces regulatory and pipeline risks the quant stack only partly captures. Verdict: watchlist — valuation looks modest, but negative screen earnings growth and sub-1× net statutory FCF/dividend cover need USD filing reconciliation before treating yield as safe.

MONY.L (MONY Group plc, Communication Services) — Strong buy (13/22 models, composite 75%) adjusted to buy; passes include Economic Moat, Piotroski 7/9, Earnings Quality, and Financial Health despite failing Graham Enterprising (P/B 4.3). Metrics: P/E 10.8, yield 7.3%, ROE 37.1%; filing FCF £98.1M vs screen TTM £80M; statutory dividend cover 1.47×. Timing overlay favours entry (RSI 29, accumulate). Dividend family fails; Lynch PEG fails on ~2% filing basic EPS growth. Only five weeks at signal vs 23 for most peers. Verdict: accumulate — oversold timing and solid statutory cover near 1.5×, tempered by high P/B, thin earnings growth, and dividend-family failure on yield-dependent models.

- MEGP.L: 7.1% yield passes Low P/E + High Yield, but net statutory FCF cover is 0.84× (gross/management 1.68×)—ordinary dividend may not be fully funded on OCF−CapEx if photobooth/discretionary demand weakens further; interim-quality and cyclical-exposure overlays already adjusted strong buy to buy. Piotroski 6/9; FCF Yield suppressed. No carve-out/discontinued-ops flag in JSON (`transition_key`: new). Dividend family failed—do not treat yield alone as sustainable.
- FGP.L: FCF figures diverge sharply (filing £362.6M, screen TTM £302.8M, company-adj £73.8M; policy uses company-adj); headline 9.32× statutory cover in action note vs ~1.90× on adjusted basis in prompts—open which basis matches ongoing rail/bus capex and lease-adjusted debt. Yahoo D/E 161% vs £137.7m adj. net debt; current ratio 0.73 and Financial Health fail flag liquidity/governance of working-capital swings in transport. Adjusted EPS screen vs filing mismatch (−5.9% vs +16.0%). No uk_contractor flag; not a pension-deficit name in payload—pension/regulatory exposure for UK transport is an open qualitative question.
- MGNS.L: UK building/construction cyclicality (margin/backlog risk) not fully encoded without Companies House margin series in this JSON. FCF filing vs TTM gap (£170.7M vs £141.5M) modest vs peers; statutory cover 2.59× is stronger than yield-focused peers but dividend models still suppressed. Economic Moat fails on ROA/margins—competitive pressure in contracting is an open question.
- HIK.L: Filing $119M FCF vs screen TTM $14.4M—Yahoo TTM is not filing-aligned; net statutory cover 0.64× vs 4.1% yield implies dividend risk if the lower TTM cash generation persists. Screen earnings growth −4.7% conflicts with diluted EPS growth +12.4% in inputs—basis mismatch for GARP. USD reporting vs GBP listing adds FX translation risk for UK holders. Healthcare pricing/regulatory and generic competition not scored in detail.
- MONY.L: 7.3% yield with statutory cover 1.47× is thin buffer for a classified-ad/lead-gen model; P/B 4.3 fails Graham Enterprising. Filing basic EPS growth ~2% vs screen adjusted 4.7%—guidance credibility open. Dividend Growth model cites “earnings not growing” alongside FCF basis suppression. No discontinued-ops/carve-out signal in JSON.
deep_analysis.red_flags:
NAMES WORTH DEEPER RESEARCH

- MEGP.L — On the latest interim and annual filings, does statutory OCF−CapEx cover the ordinary dividend after photobooth revenue trends, and how does that reconcile to management’s 1.68× “cash-generated minus CapEx” bridge in IR materials?
- FGP.L — Which FCF definition (£362.6M filing, £302.8M screen TTM, or £73.8M company-adjusted) matches continuing operations post-lease accounting, and does adjusted net debt of £137.7m adequately cover pension, franchise, and working-capital needs given current ratio 0.73?
- MGNS.L — From multi-year Companies House “YYYY in numbers” (if in scope) and recent RNS, how are adjusted operating margin and secured workload trending into the next UK construction downcycle, versus the screen’s 18.8% earnings growth and 2.59× statutory dividend cover?

Prefer top focus lines + market warning triage (deepen/dismiss/park on open admission flags — zero_body/unmeasured are not dismissable; spare DAX stall → park; do not ritual-clear health=warn or starve euro fat slot) + new_info human tasks; check History for yesterday’s Accept followed vs Discuss resolved. Hub should be fresh before 04:00 Europe/London (early ops-monitor ~02:30 UTC). Do not treat Suite A stress green or graduated badges as adoption. Accept runs safe observe-acks only; Discuss queues Project pickup for fat-slot judgment. Accept-streak hints are observe-only — never auto-flip automated:true.

tasks.title: Triage paper-learning and learning-director tasks
tasks.summary: These queues have no promote CLI. Remaining: watch u4 (ldr-20260823-02) and exit-shadow (ana-20260728-04); leave L111 replay as continue. Buffered-hold and IMB.L audits are done. Do not reopen duplicate human-ack wrappers. Prefer the engineering queue for the two scoring tasks.

tasks.title: Horizon scan + deferred fragments
tasks.summary: First Sunday 11:00 UTC: weeder applies deterministic near-dup / already-an-idea DROPs; read horizon scan; triage remaining open fragments and deferred ideas. apply_fragments stays off unless you reviewed the markdown.

tasks.title: Verify decision packs before live capital
tasks.summary: For real-money trades, use decision-pack verify checklist and primary sources — separate from the automated learning loop.

tasks.title: Review knob calibration priors
tasks.summary: Confirm readiness signals in knob_calibration_priors.json (confidence, score_gap_vs_runner_up, ready_for_*). If confidence is low/insufficient and score gap shows no discrimination (<0.005), Acknowledge (observe-only) and stop — do not promote. Promotion is a separate gate (sunday-promote-knobs-gate).

analysis.headline: Knob priors · ack sufficient (no discrimination)
bullets: Review gate = confirm readiness signals; Acknowledge is enough when confidence is low and score gap shows no discrimination.
No discrimination → Acknowledge (observe-only); do not promote. Promotion is sunday-promote-knobs-gate.

tasks.title: Read analysis review synthesis
tasks.summary: After analysis-review (~10:35 UTC), read analysis_review.md for backward metrics, proposed experiments, ingest trials, and the observe-only buy-tier chart-outcome mix (well timed / giveback / no terrible).

tasks.title: Review open ingest deviations and reprocess if needed
tasks.summary: When Automation → Ingest deviations shows open rows, follow observe-only signal_triage (leftover → dismiss, buy → park/hunter via dismiss, strong_buy → approve pin). Approve writes a 7-day intensive pin; dismiss closes 7 days. Do not auto-replace IR URLs.

automated_tasks.title: Spot-check learning tracks after paper-auto
automated_tasks.summary: ops-monitor (13:15 catch-up) checks post-settle last_run, decision-review coverage of AI judgment vs rules, competing calibrated shadows, and Suite B buy_tier_level. Workflow freshness covers CI acted. Excess vs ^FTSE comparison stays Sunday — do not promote on weekday marks.

automated_tasks.title: Paper-auto + decision-review apply
automated_tasks.summary: Runs all learning tracks (including competing calibrated shadows and the Suite B buy_tier_level cohort), refreshes overlay, appends rebalance_log, applies clamped knobs when history is thick. Shadows and the cohort lab are observe-only (no --apply); endurance ledger refreshes after review.

automated_tasks.title: GHA secret hygiene scan
automated_tasks.summary: Daily Actions scan for public-repo workflow_run secret-exposure patterns. Skips when no main merges / workflow touches in the last 36h; always runs on PRs that change workflows. Failures open a supervised engineering task.

automated_tasks.title: Admitted epoch-0 local-open marks
automated_tasks.summary: library-epoch0-weekday.yml marks admitted buy_tier_level books after ASX / EU / US open+settle. Session gate skips pre-settle and already-marked local days. No AI track, no knob apply, not FTSE paper-auto at 08:25 UTC. Census refresh writes equal_support_status.json.

automated_tasks.title: Epoch-0 weekday local-open crons (admit + sync)
automated_tasks.summary: On learning admit and on euro-ingest-dispatch --sync-cron, upsert timezone-bucket cron-job.org jobs (asx/euro/us-edt/us-est) for admitted markets. Ingest/sprint/maintenance workflows pass CRONJOB_API_KEY + WORKFLOW_DISPATCH_PAT. Soft-skips when secrets are missing. Do not attach these to FTSE weekday_paper at 08:25 UTC.

automated_tasks.title: Admitted-market weekday rememo
automated_tasks.summary: After library ingest maintenance, rememo up to 3 body-lag buy-tier names per admitted/epoch-0 market (same cap as FTSE). Catch-up to 5 when that market's backlog exceeds 15. Once per weekday. No AI / no Sunday dump / no 21-market spray.

automated_tasks.title: Project traffic pause / unstick / EOD digest
automated_tasks.summary: Weekday project-traffic (and ops-monitor) classifies stuck cursor/* PRs, pauses new engineering-agent dispatch, comments for CI/conflict fixes (appending pr_fix_occasions.json with failure reasons), may dispatch conflict-resolve for eng branches, stops Composer reburn / Cursor fail-loop automation waste (park burning tasks + pause), and writes a grounded EOD digest that lists today's eng merges (including independently verified ingest_narrow / scoring_narrow / compile_cap_drain auto-merges) plus common PR-fix failure reasons. Automation → Queue & hunter monitor shows today/yesterday merge counts, a 14-day auto vs manual merge bar chart, and PR-fix intervention tallies. Spot-check digest trajectory and the merges-today list when pause is active, auto-merges land, or a cohesion_bypass task still needed human merge because the actual diff stayed over the path cap.

automated_tasks.title: Confirm buy-tier level cohort first fill
automated_tasks.summary: ops-monitor fails when buy_tier_level acted with an empty book. Knobs stay frozen. Do not treat first-fill NAV as promotion truth (Sunday gates).

automated_tasks.title: FTSE buy-tier level DCA realism (£500/mo)
automated_tasks.summary: Paper-auto runs buy_tier_level_dca (same level-book policy, monthly_deposit=500, cold-start capital epoch). Overlays FTSE Overview held-vs-market as branch series with deposit-matched ^FTSE. Not a promotion gate; recycling buy_tier_level stays the primary held line.

automated_tasks.title: Dual-path sleeve episodes (observe-only)
automated_tasks.summary: Paper-auto opens/updates widest sleeve episodes (near-buy hold@≥0.28 or buy-tier → grace-end+~1m / fallback leave-wide×confirms+~1m) with capital_status tags (on_book / off_book / never_funded). Does not change allocation or NAV scoreboard. Manual: ftse-sleeve-episodes.

automated_tasks.title: Phase C readiness assessment (observe-only)
automated_tasks.summary: Sunday analysis-review runs ftse-phase-c-readiness and writes docs/data/phase_c_readiness.json. Checks Phase B slim evidence, ≥8 weeks AI-judgment rebalance_log with buy-tier/candidates, and non-trivial feature coverage. Does not fail the Sunday job on NOT READY.

automated_tasks.title: Watch ingest capacity as more markets come on stream
automated_tasks.summary: Spare sprint auto-advance down the queue is correct. Crowded maintenance defaults to 2 markets/slot (L454); ftse-library maintenance-capacity-review steps width or proposes matrix from samples. Confirm library-ingest-maintenance still finishes inside 120 minutes; the 62-name deepen cap is usually not binding.

automated_tasks.title: Admitted-market epoch-0 shard (buy-tier-level + near-miss)
automated_tasks.summary: Ladder stamps equal-support timing (and near-miss / exclusion archives) before ftse-library shard-epoch0 so skip_timing_wait can drop timing_signal=wait from new buys. Wait names stay on the observe-only near_miss_watch.json sample. Sunday prefers first-time memos and rememos the focus book only; admitted body-lag rememo and local-open marks are weekday jobs. No AI-judgment track and no knob apply.

automated_tasks.title: Full-period knob calibrate + shadow bootstrap
automated_tasks.summary: analysis-review.yml runs ftse-knob-calibrate with full_period_retrospective, writes bootstrap_priors, spawns competing shadows, PIT warm-starts them from parent rebalance_log (forward-only endurance zero datum), and refreshes endurance.

Soft-skips when CRONJOB_API_KEY or WORKFLOW_DISPATCH_PAT is missing. Manual re-import only if the workflow was deleted or secrets were absent.

market_status.note: Per-market stage and health snapshot for the dashboard grid. Ingest mode uses cached dispatch + policy lists; signal mix comes from the live FTSE screen or each library latest_summary.json. Admitted markets show epoch-0 buy-tier-level + equal-support near-miss (watch cut: buy-not-now / hold-near-buy). Sprint tiles add a 2-day ingest rollup and admission-progress flags. learning_gate is an observe-only Start → Bodies → Sprint → Admit → Epoch-0 → Parity → live-ready stepper with next-gate criteria and timeframe; live FTSE shows live-path status, not self catch-up. held_vs_market plots held-stock value vs local-index equivalent; knob-changed branches overlay the same dates when applied. Do not blend NAV into the gate graphic.

held_vs_market.note: Held-stock value vs the same capital in ^FTSE (recycling epoch-0). DCA £500/mo book overlays the cold-start realism twin; DCA £500/mo in ^FTSE is the deposit-matched index path for that twin.
